scores.label: A
scores.note: Every option uses 'detrimental' correctly and uses only the paragraph's ideas. But each one copies a paragraph sentence almost word for word with a clause added, so it is long and redundant. Option 4 is a run-on (because...because...since). Option 5's 'detrimental to doing better on tests' is awkward. Option 2's 'not detrimental' is vague.
